name: Pasifik Holding
verdict: Turkish holding (real estate, logistics, technology, energy and mining) whose main shareholders are Fatih Erdoğan, Abdulkerim Fırat and Mehmet Erdoğan, with 26.67% each. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the shareholder table lists three individuals with 26.67% each and 19.99% in holdings below 5%, so no state or state fund holds 5% or more; the board page's biographies show no member in a current state office (some are former officials: CEO Nusret Dur left Ziraat Bankası in 2018). No state link → none. Front-of-shirt sponsor of Galatasaray since 2025-26; Sporx (6 June 2026) reports the Süper Lig deal continues, revised to €10m.
